name: Streaming Advanced Topics For Blockchain Based Applications A788854637
text: Advanced Topics for Blockchain‐Based Applications presents the following source proposition: As blockchain technology matures, the pursuit of innovative applications encounters a spectrum of complexities that extend beyond the foundational principles. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Traditional jurisdictional principles cannot directly apply to blockchain technology because the blockchain is merely a collection of agreed upon calculations by decentralized computer systems, and no particular node holds the entire blockchain.
